There is a trend of increasing stigmatisation of human rights defenders and organisations by the media, some authorities, companies and a number of illegal activities taking place in the communities territories. This is taking place against a backdrop of growing social tensions and conflict. One of the factors that has contributed to the conflict is the weakness of comprehensive territorial, environmental and conflict-related policies.
